chapter: Zulu, family and old New Orleans
title: His daughter's birth and his quick courtship and marriage
summary: Guesnon says his daughter was born in 1925 when he was 18, and jokes about meeting his wife on Monday and marrying her on Friday.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: When was she born your daughter?
Born 1925. I got married the day I made her, 18 years old.

Mm-hmm. I met my wife on a Monday and I married her that Friday. Poor dick. You were quick in those days. Oh yeah, quick. First night, first night went to see her. Second night, put my arms around her. Third night kiss her and the fourth night was up under a crow and the fifth year got married.
Was that kind of marriage that was decided by your parents or something?
